# dartdoc.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow API documentation.</link-summary>

```text
Generates the API documentation of the packages with dart doc. On pull requests it only checks
that the documentation builds; otherwise it hands the HTML to pages.yml as the part api: one
package at the root of the part, several packages in subdirectories with an index page.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  dartdoc:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/dartdoc.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before (pipeline.yml passes its own); empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace. |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `publishable-only` | boolean | `true` | Only document packages that are published (no publish_to none). |
| `validate-links` | boolean | `true` | Report broken links as warnings (not on dry runs); with fail-on-warnings they fail the job. |
| `fail-on-warnings` | boolean | `false` | Fail when dart doc warns. |
| `dry-run-on-pr` | boolean | `true` | On pull requests only check that the documentation builds. |
| `args` | string | empty | Extra arguments for dart doc. |
| `title` | string | empty | Title of the index page for several packages; empty uses the repository name. |
| `pages-part-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Hand the documentation to pages.yml as the part api. |
| `sdk` | string | `stable` | Dart SDK (stable, beta or a version). |
| `flutter-version` | string | `stable` | Flutter version, used when a documented package is a Flutter package. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `20` | Timeout of the job. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run before any tool is set up. |
| `post-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run after the dependencies are resolved. |
| `artifact-retention-days` | number | `7` | Days to keep the artifact. |
| `pub-hosted-url` | string | empty | URL of a private package host; its token is the secret PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN. |
| `git-host` | string | `github.com` | Host of private git dependencies; its token is the secret GIT_DEPS_TOKEN. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
